data.change_summary: No additional fixes were applied in this Apply Fixes stage. The latest review approved the trim-plants, shrimp-mortality, and gross budget-ledger amendments without follow-up changes, so the code remains as produced in the most recent implement stage.
outstanding_risks: Stages that still rely on snapshot-derived gross component budgets can collapse same-component turnover within a single pass until they emit explicit source/sink budgets; the main remaining candidates are complex multi-process stages such as `system:nitrogen_cycle` and some daily biology passes.

The canonical-helper coverage guard is convention-based rather than exhaustive reflection. Future element-bearing fields with non-standard names or fields hidden in empty-by-default collections will require extending the discovery rules and tests.

Shrimp reproductive state is still modeled as counts/cohorts rather than explicit element-bearing egg biomass, so any future explicit clutch or egg-mass model must extend the canonical totals and routing.
